title: Signal: TLS verification disabled (dart) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on TLS-disabling settings in dart code or config.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches the switch regardless of environment. Per-client verify=False forms are separate rules.

examples.line: # audit: client.badCertificateCallback = (cert, host, port) => true; present

fpNotes: Local test harnesses against self-signed fixtures are the common false positive — confirm test scope.
